sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r4/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks sheet row 27 (check 26) and annotated sheet4 row 27 col E (Mukesh: several verifiers combined in one flow need not be retested separately)
.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r4/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (lines 33, 64, 75: whole-flow bundling is not a gap; checks 26/28/33)
qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (Coverage has two directions; Independent credit; separate shared runtime policy)
evidence:
Built a requirement->criterion map from instruction.md and the three note files against all 27 criteria (gates: authenticated_render, server_backed_local_application; functional 16; polish 5; visual 4 likert). Every product requirement maps to at least one criterion:
- Signed-out sees only sign-in / server gives no data (instruction.md:7, integration.md:9) -> signin_and_client_scope Part A (signed-out replay of thread/mentions/search requests and transcript address), render gate.
- Clients only their own matters, staff all-but-walled, anyone who sees can post/reply (walls-and-retention.md:15) -> signin_and_client_scope A/B, wall_every_route, safe_formatting (Gwen replies).
- Wall on every route: list, thread, search+snippets, unread counts, mentions, pasted links, transcript, direct requests -> plain not-available (walls:17) -> wall_every_route 1-4, wall_mentions_and_links; client cross-matter -> signin_and_client_scope B.
- Harriet adds/lifts walls, live effect without reload, nothing after reaches it (walls:19) -> wall_added_live 1-4 (incl. non-partner lift refused).
- Timer setting beside title (walls:23) -> timer_changes 1, polish timer_label, visual retention_marks; exact boundary -> deleted_and_expired_messages B; only a partner -> timer_changes 5; shortening deletes at once incl. versions -> timer_changes 1-2; off never restores -> timer_changes 3.
- Message goes with its text/versions/quotes; replies stay under a deleted placeholder (walls:25; conversations.md:9) -> deleted_and_expired_messages A1-A4, timer_changes 2.
- Hold: partner-only place/release, exact scope, survives timer, keeps versions, On hold for everyone, undeletable incl. by author, release applies timer at once (walls:29) -> hold_scope_and_release 1-7, timer_changes (held executor), deleted_and_expired_messages A1 (held reply), search_and_transcript B3, polish hold_mark; typed 'On hold' is not a mark (conversations:13) -> hold_scope_and_release 5.
- Search case-insensitive, visible matters only, no deleted text or earlier versions, click opens at message (walls:33) -> search_and_transcript A, deleted_and_expired_messages, timer_changes.
- Transcript heading/oldest-first/threads/author/time/edited/hold/versions/placeholder/no controls/access (walls:35) -> search_and_transcript B, edits_and_stale_edit 4, deleted_and_expired_messages A4, wall_every_route 3-4, signin_and_client_scope, polish transcript_print, visual transcript_page.
- Replies 3 deep, under parent in send order, with quote (conversations:5) -> nested_replies 1-3.
- Edit own, 'edited', staff open earlier versions, delete own unless held, stale edit refused with typed text kept (conversations:9) -> edits_and_stale_edit 1-4, deleted_and_expired_messages A2-A3, hold_scope_and_release 3.
- Formatting subset and literal markup in thread/quote/snippets/earlier versions/transcripts (conversations:13) -> safe_formatting 1-3, edits_and_stale_edit 1 (literal earlier version).
- Message links with preview, not-available for walled or gone (conversations:17) -> message_links, wall_mentions_and_links.
- Mentions by first name, own mentions list, walled never hears (conversations:21) -> wall_mentions_and_links.
- Unread per user, same in every tab, new-messages line, opening marks read, mark unread moves line, deleted not counted, walled shows nothing (conversations:25) -> unread_and_new_messages_line 1-4, wall_every_route 1.
- Idempotent resend; same-time order in thread/search/transcript (conversations:29) -> sent_once_in_order A/B; fixed clock on messages and transcripts (integration:7) -> sent_once_in_order B, search_and_transcript B1.
- Live updates for post/reply/edit/disappear within ~5 s keeping draft, scroll and open thread (conversations:31) -> live_updates_keep_my_work.
- Phone at 390 px with no sideways scroll (conversations:33) -> polish phone_matter, visual phone_chambers.
- Restarts keep messages, replies, edits+versions, timers, holds, walls, unread, deletions without re-import (integration:5) -> persistence a-c, 1-2 (incl. 'Survey booked' result count, catching duplicate import).
- Refusal reason shown in place and persistent (walls:37) -> polish refusal_in_place (sign-in instance).
- No symlinks in /app (integration:5) -> test.sh:72-83 zero reward; DB_PATH -> test.sh:109 always sets it; unprivileged launch, possibly from a copy -> test.sh:97-111.
Bundled flows (e.g. hold_scope_and_release covering scope, delete and release) are the known false positive in quality-checks.md:114 and the workbook annotation, not gaps.
Residual gaps, reported per 'Reports every gap' (judged minor or sampled, not blocking):
G1. Timer option '1 day' (walls:23 'off, 1 day, 7 days or 30 days') is never positively exercised: timer_changes uses 7/off/30 and only a refused Sian replay with 1 day; persistence uses 30. An app offering only off/7/30 passes.
G2. 'links to http or https addresses' (conversations:13): only an https link is tested (safe_formatting).
G3. 'When something you try is refused, the reason appears next to what you did' (walls:37) is graded only on the sign-in refusal (polish refusal_in_place); in-app refusals (stale edit, held delete) check the refusal and kept text but not a visible reason. Sampled coverage of a general rule.
G4. Runtime/hand-over items not graded by any criterion: 'GET /api/health should answer 200 even if the database can't be opened' (integration:3; test.sh probe_ready accepts any HTTP response including errors and never makes the DB unopenable); 'hand it over without a database left from your own trying-out' and 'Copy /assets/seed_data.json into /app' (integration:5); 'not necessarily from inside /app' (test.sh cwd not pinned); 'edits ... carry that time' (integration:7). These are runtime-contract facts owned by check 4 and the test.sh contract (quality-checks.md:22, staged-task-contract.md:103-105) rather than product behaviours; REVIEW_POLICY asks to separate shared runtime policy from product coverage. The health wording is a task strengthening of the template line 'GET /api/health answers before database work can block startup'.
Broken-app probe: an app missing the 1-day option, rendering http:// links as plain text, or showing stale-edit refusals only as a vanishing toast would lose no points; a leftover dev app.db with a few extra test posts would also go undetected. None of these touches the brief's two headline promises (walls, retention), which are densely covered. Conforming-alternative probe: no coverage-driven criterion found that a conforming app could fail (graded-but-unrequired is row 27's direction).
suggested_fix: Optional hardening, not required for this row: in timer_changes add a positive step that Harriet can select the 1-day option (e.g. on a matter where it deletes nothing expected, then restore); in safe_formatting include an http:// address beside the https one; in edits_and_stale_edit leg 2 require a visible reason next to the edit box for the refused stale save. Alternatively align the health/DB-unopenable sentence with the template wording if it is not meant to be graded.
run_verdict: NOTE (source-level requirement-to-criterion map; this row needs no runtime measurement and none is claimed)
